say: Hi, I'm Yefry Núñez, a twenty-seven-year-old software and AI developer from San Antonio de Guerra, a small town in the Dominican Republic.
Across Latin America, public procurement data is open by law. But it is too technical for the people who need it most: small businesses, and citizens asking where their money goes.
That is why I created Contractor AI. It reads government contracts and flags prices far above similar past contracts.
tts: That is why I created Contractor A I. It reads government contracts and flags prices far above similar past contracts.

say: For me, building technology is also an ethical choice. Every alert is framed as 'warrants review', never as a verdict, and a person always makes the final decision.
With this work, I became the first Dominican to win HackCorruption, and it was recognized by the Organization of American States.
As a Dalai Lama Fellow, I want to learn contemplative practices that help me lead with compassion, and bring this work closer to the communities it is meant to serve.
Because transparency should not depend on expensive tools or specialized knowledge. Thank you.
